name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments.
eligibility_text: All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Passbook, Land Records

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of failure of any of the notified crops.
eligibility_text: All farmers including tenant farmers and sharecroppers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Land Record or Tenancy Agreement, Bank Details

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / RBI
benefits: Adequate and timely credit support from the banking system under a single window for their cultivation and other needs.
eligibility_text: All farmers, owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers, SHGs or JLGs of farmers.
documents_needed: ID Proof, Address Proof, Land Documents, Passport size photographs

name: Rythu Bandhu (Investment Support for Agriculture)
benefits: Investment support of Rs. 10,000 per acre per year (Rs. 5000 for Kharif and Rs. 5000 for Rabi).
eligibility_text: All farmers of the State having cultivable land to the extent of land possessed / owned by them are eligible. Tenant farmers are NOT eligible (as per current rules).
documents_needed: Pattadar Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details

name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income augmentation)
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Empowerment, Odisha
benefits: Financial support of Rs. 25,000 over 5 seasons for small/marginal farmers. Rs. 12,500 for landless agricultural households.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land, and vulnerable agricultural households (landless).
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Land records (RoR)
